Text: AirStation HighPower N600 Gigabit DualBand Wireless Router

This router shares the same FCC ID as the Buffalo WZR-HP-AG300H. It presumed to be identical or very close to identical (besides the name). The images for the device are still labeled WZR-HP-AG300H on the Buffalo site.
The default SSIDs appear to be the MAC address of the unit (with no delimiters) with a '_A' or '_G' suffix depending on the band.
Buffalo forums: CPU: Atheros AR7161 rev.2, 32MB Flash, 128MB RAM
The RAM IC used may alternately be a Hynix H5DU5162ETR-E3C.
Per the OpenWrt wiki, the two wireless interfaces have PCI subsystems of 168c:a097 and 168c:a096.
